crossRefs.note: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.
The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and…

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
translations.bsb: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, He departed, and Abraham returned home.
translations.kjv: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
translations.asv: And Jehovah went his way, as soon as he had left off communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
